details:
The features of groups are quite lacking. The banned list and player list needs a sort and search button. So that people can easily see if a friend has joined the group, or for an admin to see if a friend is banned unjustly.

Group moderation is a bit too lax. I feel like there needs to be guidelines set specifically for group instances, and I think vrchat official moderators should have access to audio logs 10 to 30 minutes prior to each kick or ban, so that if somebody should report a group for breaking group community guidelines.

I've seen too many people kicked for little to no reason and nothing is being done about it. I watched the creator of a group turn to a guy and say "I'm bored, you're boring me" and then banned them from the group. I feel like something that severe should prevent the group from being able to make any kind of group instances except for private group instances. Personally I'd have also put a public ban on the offender as well, for up to 7 days preventing them from joining any public lobbies. But that might be a bit harsh.

As it stands right now, some people are scared to join any group instances for fear of being kicked unjustly. I posted a ticket in the discord and every response I got was along the lines of "Don't go to group instances" instead of "yeah they should be penalized" So I came up with this balanced way of punishing abusive admins. Sure it's a bit over the top but I think it'll make group publics a lot more safe.
title: Group Overhaul
